name: proto-blocks/cadco-product-archive
title: Cadco Product Archive
description: The catalogue listing: a breadcrumb and display title, a left rail carrying the category's sub-categories and a refinement select, and a grid of product cards with a result count. Everything on it is read from the query, so it is placed once in the product archive template and serves every category.

titleFormat.label: Page title
titleFormat.help: %s is replaced by the category being viewed. Leave %s out to use the same title everywhere.

shopTitle.label: Name for the whole catalogue
shopTitle.help: Used for the title, the rail and the breadcrumb when no category is being viewed — the shop page, and the editor canvas.

showRail.label: Show the category rail
showRail.help: The left-hand column: the category name, its sub-categories, View All, and the refinement select.

filterAttribute.label: Refine by attribute
filterAttribute.help: A WooCommerce product attribute taxonomy, e.g. pa_size. The select is left out when the attribute does not exist, or when no product in view carries it.

columns.label: Columns
columns.help: Narrower screens step down to two, then one.

perPage.label: Products per page
perPage.help: The design draws five rows of three.

showPrice.label: Show prices
showPrice.help: This catalogue lists prices but sells nothing, so the price is a list price, not an offer.
